metadata.summary: Chris Dobey clinched his third ranking title of the season as he beat Tommy Morris 8-4 at Players Championship 32 on Thursday.
metadata.content: Players Championship 32: Chris Dobey wins third ranking title of year as Michael van Gerwen struggles | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Players Championship 32: Chris Dobey wins third ranking title of year as Michael van Gerwen struggles Michael van Gerwen knocked out by Tommy Morris, who fell to Chris Dobey in final of Players Championship 32 in Den Bosch; watch the Grand Slam of Darts live on Sky Sports from November 14-22 Thursday 29 October 2026 22:57, UK Image: Chris Dobey's decision to change darts paid dividends Chris Dobey clinched his third ranking title of the season as he beat Tommy Morris 8-4 at Players Championship 32 on Thursday. The day in Den Bosch notably featured three nine-dart finishes courtesy of Tom Sykes against Cor Dekker, Bradley Brooks against Adam Gawlas and Wesley Plaisier against Damon Heta. Dobey registered the three highest averages of the afternoon on his way to victory, averaging 103.15 across his seven matches. messages.text: 'Lack of talent' - Alonso doubles down on Albon criticism

metadata.summary: Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso has doubled down on his criticism of "low level" Formula 1 drivers who have a "lack of talent" following his collision with Williams' Alex Albon in Austin.
metadata.content: Fernando Alonso doubles down on Alex Albon and F1 field criticism ahead of Mexico City Grand Prix | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Fernando Alonso doubles down on Alex Albon and F1 field criticism ahead of Mexico City Grand Prix Two-time F1 world champion Fernando Alonso has reiterated his criticism of Williams' Alex Albon and other drivers who battle at the back of the grid in F1; watch every session of the Mexico City GP with Friday's practice sessions at 6.30pm and 10pm, live on Sky Sports F1 Thursday 29 October 2026 21:13, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso was scathing in his assessment of the talent level of the lower third of the Formula 1 grid Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso has doubled down on his criticism of "low level" Formula 1 drivers who have a "lack of talent" following his collision with Williams' Alex Albon in Austin. Albon tried to overtake Alonso for 12th place into the Turn 11 hairpin on the opening lap of the United States Grand Prix, but went into the side of the Aston Martin driver, damaging both cars. Neither driver received a penalty and both were able to continue with Alonso finishing 16th and Albon in 17th in Austin. Grealish, who is on loan from Manchester City, missed Saturday's defeat at Arsenal due to illness but had started Everton's previous three Premier League matches against Ipswich, Hull City and Chelsea. messages.text: Antonelli misses Mexico media day with viral illness

metadata.summary: Kimi Antonelli missed Thursday's media day at the Mexico City Grand Prix due to a viral illness ahead of the weekend when he will likely become Formula 1 world champion.
metadata.content: Kimi Antonelli misses Mexico City GP media day due to viral illness ahead of likely world championship coronation | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Kimi Antonelli misses Mexico City GP media day due to viral illness ahead of likely world championship coronation Championship leader Kimi Antonelli is recovering from a viral illness ahead of the weekend where he is expected to secure the Drivers' Championship; watch every session of the Mexico City GP with Friday's practice sessions at 6.30pm and 10pm, live on Sky Sports F1 Nigel Chiu Sports Journalist @NigelCJourno Thursday 29 October 2026 22:21, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player On The F1 Show podcast, Ant Davidson explains how Kimi Antonelli stays grounded as he closes in on a world title Kimi Antonelli missed Thursday's media day at the Mexico City Grand Prix due to a viral illness ahead of the weekend when he will likely become Formula 1 world champion. A top-nine finish in this Sunday's race will ensure Antonelli becomes the sport's youngest world champion at 20 years old - breaking Sebastian Vettel's record by three years. Should Antonelli not score any points on Sunday, he will still be world champion if his Mercedes team-mate George Russell or Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton don't win the race.
